name: Copperline Taproom
tagline: Twelve stools, eight taps, zero televisions.
intro: This board is the same one we chalk behind the bar, updated at every keg change. Check the gauges before you walk over — if something you love is about to blow, call and we will tell you straight how many pours are left.

faqs.question: How current is this tap list?
faqs.answer: It is the same board we run behind the bar. Whoever changes a keg updates the page in the same minute, so if a beer shows as pouring, it is pouring — and the gauges reflect what is genuinely left.

faqs.question: Something I want is about to blow. Can you hold it?
faqs.answer: We cannot reserve draft beer, but call before you head over and we will tell you honestly how many pours are left. House tradition: the last pour of any keg is on us.

faqs.question: Do you fill growlers and crowlers?
faqs.answer: Yes — 32 oz crowlers and 64 oz growlers from any tap that is not flagged as about to blow, up to 30 minutes before close.

faqs.question: Do you serve food?
faqs.answer: We keep pretzels and bar snacks behind the counter, and a food truck parks out front on Friday and Saturday evenings. You are also welcome to bring in takeaway from the neighborhood.

faqs.question: Are kids and dogs welcome?
faqs.answer: Dogs are welcome on the patio year-round and inside on weekday afternoons. Minors are welcome with an adult until 8 PM.
